description: Clip-lifetime mutants of the audio plan, killed only by an AddressSanitizer build of gyo_audio_tests (configure with -fsanitize=address, BUILD_TESTING=ON, no products, for example build/target/_build/audio-asan). Run with run_mutations.py --catalog this file --build-dir <the ASan build>.

mutants.what: LoadClip frees an unloading slot without waiting for the audio thread's hand-back, so the audio thread reads freed samples
